text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I went to watch a mock 
race.

Among the contenders were Kitasan Black 
and Sounds of Earth—

Kitasan Black dominated the race from 
start to finish. Never surrendering the 
lead, she seized victory with a brilliant 
front-running performance.

As the excitement of the race lingered and 
the sun began to dip below the horizon—

I spotted Sounds of Earth writing 
something in her notebook.
choice_data_list: (She ran in that race earlier, but...)

text_block_list.text:
She had finished in a frustrating second 
place. And yet—
choice_data_list:
(She doesn't seem all that down, does 
she...?)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Oh, my curious Papageno.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Oh, my curious Papagena.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Are you interested in me? Or perhaps in 
this score?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the very thing you're gazing at 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
This is a full orchestral score. I'm 
transcribing everything from today onto 
it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Do you remember? All the myriad sounds 
that reached your ears today.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Tap, tap.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Rustle, whoosh... Thump-thump, 
rumble-rumble—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Pa-pa-pa-pa-pa-paan!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sounds bursting forth, sounds fading away, 
resonating harmonies, overlapping rhythms!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
From pianississimo all the way to 
rinforzando—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The sounds poured forth at will by horse 
girls, people, the wind, and the 
earth—wasn't every single bit of it 
fantastico!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Did I trouble you? My apologies. And yet, 
even the tone of your voice just now...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Right here, right now, it is a sound 
unique to you alone. Those are precisely 
the kinds of sounds I wish to transcribe.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Above all, the sounds stirred up by a race 
are in a league of their own.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
They need not be flawless. Raw and 
unvarnished is fine. For it is beyond 
where they all intertwine—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That the race I seek exists—a truly 
grandioso ensemble!

Her manner of speaking was distinctive, 
but I felt I understood. What she sought 
was every single sound born from the race.

That is why she didn't fixate excessively 
on winning, and could even use defeat as 
fuel for her growth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Oh, your expression shifted again. Lovely.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Dal Segno al Coda... An ensemble with you 
is also deeply importante to me.
choice_data_list:
If I find any wonderful sounds, I'll be 
sure to share them with you.

If I find any wonderful sounds, I'll be 
sure to share them with you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Molto bene. And yet, let's see—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Right now, I find myself far, far more 
interested in the sound that is you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's the look, my dear amico. 
Won't you please let me hear your aria?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's the look, my dear amica. 
Won't you please let me hear your aria?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Dal Segno al Coda... An ensemble with you 
is also deeply importante to me.
choice_data_list:
I hope you get to encounter many more 
wonderful sounds ahead.

I hope you get to encounter many more 
wonderful sounds ahead.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Grazie. I offer a prayer for you as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ballades, scherzos, novellettes— May you 
encounter all manner of marvelous sounds.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And one day, I want you to hear it: the 
supreme race, the ultimate session.

Her smile gleamed brilliantly. I found 
myself looking forward to her future 
endeavors even more.
